note: Checked against Italian and English Wikipedia species pages, not against Flora d'Italia (its text layer does not contain these species). Grey alder (Alnus incana) could not be checked, so it is grouped with Italian alder. Black pine and Calabrian pine (Pinus nigra subsp. laricio) are one species in modern taxonomy, so the key returns both. Splits marked 'hard to separate' return more than one species.

Broad, flat leaves
